participation.context: Wrote the catch and stopped before the cure.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Has not seen the page, and was not shown it.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You wrote that every voice had become the king's, and that the cure was the second pass. You kept Kemp off the page.

title: Caught the uncles as fine as the nephew

participation.context: Restored the three breaths and wrote the line.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You took your own convenience out of the scene. The sheet was cleaner at the end than at the start. You set the tables line and left the foot empty.

title: Gave the uncles their breaths back

description: Not all of them may sing

participation.context: Wrote the line on the tables.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the sentence in the wax and did not write under it.

title: Closed the tables on not all of them may sing
